Name: Sirus23 Mod Collection
Author: Sirus, Jared
Description: Animal companions, a working sheep farm and felt clothing. Wolf, Fox and Owl companions come from character-creation perks, or tame them in the wild (the lone Wolf, the Fox and the Owl; offering meat to a wolf pack wins a Wolf Pup). The Wolf hunts, guards camp and feeds itself, the Fox scouts for resources, shortens journeys and helps you forage while it follows, and the Owl watches your camp at night, makes mouse raids on your food rarer while it is beside you, and roosts in a cave by day. A wild Hawk can be tamed, or raised from an Eyas found at bird's nests in spring, and sent hunting for hare and partridge. A Ferret in your pack makes Snares and Log Traps likelier to catch a hare, and with Herbs and Fungi a trained Piglet becomes a Truffle Hog that helps you dig up truffles. A Recall Whistle calls back a companion you left behind, and a Wolf Den or Owl Perch at camp slows its companion's Hunger and Morale loss. Sheep Husbandry covers milking, wool, cheese, butter, yogurt, dairy dishes and preserving, a Sheep Feeder with Tend Flock for herd-shearing, a Sheep Pen and a Sheep Bell, and five sheep perks. Unpenned sheep risk wandering off or falling to predators overnight, even a flock left behind when you travel. A Bull can pull an Ox Plough or an Ox Cart, sheep drop manure for the compost bin, and wool yarn goes onto any base-game loom. Felt Working turns wool into Felted Wool, Felt Hats, Mittens, Vests, Boots, a Bedroll and a Rug, plus Wool Socks, with dyeing and a small set bonus, and Lanolin rubbed into a felt or wool piece gives it a few days of Rain Protection. Lanolin can stand in for Fat in six base-game recipes (needs CSFF Mod Framework 2.28.0 or later).
